title.zh: 虚构例子、反例与私人练习
title.en: A fictional example, counterexample and private exercise

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创场景：两人准备一份虚构周末书单，一人想边挑边聊，另一人想先各挑三本再交换。共同参与可以只是最后一起选一本，不要求整个过程同步。比较的对象是参与方式，不是推荐是否优秀；另一维度上的计划是否提前确定，仍需另问。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, two people prepare an invented weekend reading list. One wants to talk while choosing; the other wants to pick three books separately before comparing. Shared participation could mean selecting just the final book together rather than synchronising every step. Compare participation rather than recommendation quality; whether the plan is settled in advance belongs to the other dimension.

paragraphs.zh: “我想一起参与的是哪一步？你更愿意边做边聊，还是整理好再交流？”把共同部分写具体，再留一个可以不同步的部分；对方可以提出第三种安排。
paragraphs.en: “Which step would I like us to share? Would you rather talk while choosing or compare after preparing?” Name the shared part and leave another part open to separate work. The other person may propose a third arrangement.

paragraphs.zh: 这些是可选的讨论素材，不是对你或他人的行为报告。两组各12题分别计数，分别计分不证明统计独立；6:6保留并列，7:5也不是偏好强度或百分位。可只读公开指南或写不发送的草稿，分享不需要公开答案、次数或私人经历，也不必联系任何人。
paragraphs.en: These optional discussion examples are not behaviour reports about you or anyone else. Each group has twelve separately counted items; separate scoring does not establish statistical independence. A 6:6 tie remains, while 7:5 is neither preference intensity nor a percentile. Reading the public guide or drafting an unsent sentence is enough. Sharing requires no answers, counts, personal history or contact with anyone.

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创场景：两人虚构地各写一张故事卡，一人想先独立完成草稿，再决定分享哪些句子。保留草稿并不决定最后是否合写；愿意共同发表，也不等于愿意公开全部修改记录。这里区分个人处理空间与共同成果，不能由此推断感情距离。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, two fictional writers each draft a story card. One wants to finish privately before choosing which sentences to share. Keeping a private draft does not decide whether the final piece will be joint; agreeing to a joint publication does not mean sharing every revision. Separate processing space and shared output are different matters, without an inference about emotional distance.

paragraphs.zh: “我想先整理自己的版本；哪些共同决定需要另约时间？”可以只在纸上区分私有草稿、可分享内容与待协商事项。个人空间不是替对方取消已经共同确认的安排。
paragraphs.en: “I would like to organise my own version first. Which joint decisions need a separate time?” Privately distinguish a personal draft, shareable material and matters to discuss. Personal space does not cancel an arrangement already agreed together.

title.en: A fictional example, counterexample and private exercise

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创场景：虚构的手工活动需要提前准备纸张，但图案可以当天选。先确定人数与纸张数量，不等于必须把所有细节提前定完。若人数改变，可以重新核对材料，而不是把修改当作不认真。联系维度的次数也不能回答谁需要参与采购。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, an invented craft activity needs paper prepared in advance, while patterns can be chosen on the day. Settling attendance and paper quantity does not require settling every detail. A change in attendance calls for checking supplies again rather than judging seriousness. Contact-dimension counts cannot decide who needs to join the shopping.

paragraphs.zh: “哪项决定有实际截止时间，哪项只是我希望早点知道？”为虚构安排写一个最低必要共识和一个修改入口，不用设定统一的确认期限。
paragraphs.en: “Which decision has a practical deadline, and which would I simply prefer to know sooner?” Draft one minimum agreement and a way to revise it for the fictional activity, without imposing a universal confirmation period.

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创场景：虚构的故事交换活动有朗读和默读两种形式，可以等参与者表达意愿后再选。留待选择的是形式，不是把已答应的开始时间一并取消。有人喜欢新形式却需要提前知道结束时间；新体验、时间确定与联系多少可以分别讨论。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, an invented story exchange could involve reading aloud or silently. Its format could wait until participants express their wishes, without cancelling an agreed start time. Someone may welcome a new format yet need a definite finish time. New experiences, settled timing and amount of contact can be discussed separately.

paragraphs.zh: “哪些条件明确后，我们就能决定？如果仍没决定，暂时保留什么安排？”写出一个待确认条件和一个双方可讨论的备选，而不是把临时改变当作双方已经同意。
paragraphs.en: “Once which conditions are clear can we decide? What arrangement remains if we have not decided yet?” Draft one unknown condition and an alternative to discuss, without treating a last-minute change as mutual agreement.

title.zh: 虚构例子、反例与私人练习
title.en: A fictional example, counterexample and private exercise

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创场景：两份虚构答卷都可以得到6:6：一份在日常分享题选共同、出行题选独立，另一份恰好相反。相同总数没有保留具体题目的位置，不能证明两人想要相同相处方式。要比较具体安排，可以看同一情境中希望共享的时间与各自处理的部分，不以同分当作适配。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, two fictional answer sets can both produce 6:6: one chooses sharing in daily-news items and space in travel items, while the other does the reverse. Equal totals do not preserve which items were chosen and cannot establish the same preferred arrangement. Compare shared time and separate handling in a particular situation rather than treating equal counts as compatibility.

paragraphs.zh: “如果只讨论这个虚构周末，你想共同做哪一件事，又想独立处理哪一件？”双方答案可以不同，也可以暂不决定。并列保留两侧读法，不要求把实际时间平均分配。
paragraphs.en: “For this fictional weekend alone, what would you want to do together and what would you handle separately?” Different answers or an open decision are possible. Retaining both readings does not require dividing real time equally.

title.zh: 虚构例子、反例与私人练习
title.en: A fictional example, counterexample and private exercise

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创场景：虚构活动可以提前定场地、当天定内容，也可以先定内容、之后再选场地。两种安排都包含确定和弹性，却保留了不同的未知；6:6不能选出其中一个。总数没有说明哪道题对应哪种选择，也没有说明现实限制，不能把它当作通用折中方案。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, an invented activity could settle its venue first and content on the day, or settle content first and choose a venue later. Both include certainty and flexibility but leave different unknowns. A 6:6 total cannot select either arrangement: it does not identify the individual choices or practical constraints and supplies no universal compromise.

paragraphs.zh: “这件事中，哪一部分不确定会影响别人准备？哪一部分可以等条件更清楚再选？”可以只为虚构活动列两种方案和各自未知，不以各6次要求双方各让一半。
paragraphs.en: “Which uncertainty would affect someone else’s preparation, and which choice could wait for clearer conditions?” Privately list two fictional plans and their unknowns, without using six choices each to require equal concessions.
